protocol: Threshold0.5, 8-connected components of area>=4 pixels; center by rounded centroid without scaling/rotation. Best binary IoU against components from first4096 training images. Lower1% cutoff calibrated on first1024 validation images.
limitation: A finite-template similarity outlier is not a certified invalid shape. Count, relative spacing, sub-threshold fragments, intensity, and boundary placement require separate checks. No reconstruction-accuracy claim.
